scope: Backlink defaults, graph and annotation rules, mobile navigation, parser order and local preview behavior from a permitted public release inspected as text.

stylesheets.quote_colors: The pinned Yotsuba/Futaba, Yotsuba B/Burichan, Tomorrow and Photon rules establish ordinary quote colors; extension v1191 overrides only blue-family backlinks to #34345C with #DD0000 hover.

contract.setting_tip: Show who has replied to a post
contract.graph: One reverse link per source/target pair in parser order, including OP targets and self-quotes; only targets already present when the original source was parsed.
contract.annotations: Containing-thread OP quotes gain ' (OP)'; missing targets gain ' →' only on thread pages and not for explicit cross-board-style labels. Tracked ' (You)' labels precede these suffixes; page filtering precedes backlink annotations.
contract.mobile_layout: Viewport at most 480px unless the stored never-mobile value is exactly 'true'; rows below the post with independent ' #' navigation companions.
contract.desktop_menu_order: Parser.parsePost appends a post's menu before processing its outgoing backlinks. Later-to-earlier and self references place menu before row; an earlier source referencing a later DOM target creates row before menu. Verified zero-based offsets: parseThread 13583, parsePost 17233, menu append 17687, backlink call 17845, parseBacklinks 19168, target append 19928.
contract.hidden_posts: Hidden or filtered sources still contribute rows; hidden targets hide their backlink rows.
contract.preview: Local clones can show backlinks; mobile backlink rows are hidden in the popup. A backlink-triggered preview may mark the first exact matching reverse quote among at least two direct quote-link children.

rewrite_boundaries: Validate same-origin rewrite routes, current board and explicit thread membership rather than trusting a prefix-blind numeric fragment lookup.
Use bounded graph and finite DOM work, atomic annotation preflight and exact controller ownership.
Construct known preview rows after finite post-tree validation, within both added-row and remaining-preview budgets.
Serve one fixed page-only module with no runtime imports, network capability or worker permission; preserve the original parser-worker ceiling.
No remote graph discovery, leaked source or production user/media fixture imported.
